# MobileChat

**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![MobileChat: screenshot 1](./mobilechat/img/mobilechat.png)

</div>

MobileChat sends and receives SMS through a Siemens phone and displays conversations in a chat format. The program maintains a contact list, saves history, assembles long messages, performs transliteration, and shows sending and delivery details.

Version 2.4.1 supports Russian phonebook entries; support for the C55 was added in version 2.0.
